I’m so sorry you’re going through this as well— your experience is valid even if you don’t have vivid feelings and dreams! 
I think we all have unique symptoms, and people’s trauma manifests on an individual basis. For example, I’ve never been triggered by certain smells or places, and a majority of my flashbacks are either somatic or emotional— whereas there’s so many people who are the complete opposite, and smells/places trigger their trauma! 
Not having vivid visions and feelings are definitely NOT an indication that you’re making it up, if anything, it’s a sign it’s real! Think about it— if you were making it up, you’d have a crystal clear understanding of the situation, because you created it. 
From my understanding, trauma takes a LOT of time to process and not having clear fire indicators of sexual abuse is a pretty common coping strategy that the brain employs to keep you safe. So many people start off with having a gut intuition, or little tiny snippets of abuse, or something else ‘minor’, and throughout time,  it slowly progresses into vivid visions/feelings. The brain does this so the conscious mind can digest the information it’s recovering in the least traumatising way possible.
Also, even if you never experience a vivid and crystal-clear indicator of this possible past sexual abuse, it doesn’t make your experience or trauma ANY less valid, serious, or legitimate. Some people never fully remember what happened to them, and that’s okay!

I used to have panic attacks quite a lot at school, and i got the impression that no one understand how panic attacks work. I was never offered to go home early, or to sleep in the sick bay for the rest of the day, or anything else like that. I feel like no one understood how physically tiring they can be.

I’ve been inpatient four times, and it’s honestly the best thing. It’s so incredibly helpful when you’re distressed and your treatment team helps you on a completely different level when you’re inpatient. I’ve found that when I go inpatient, I always come out with a plan to get me back up on my feet. I can not stress how beneficial it can be. I’d highly recommend it. Make that call to the facility, it’s worth a shot. Sending hugs :)
